# FUTO Bar Association (FBA)

> The FUTO Bar Association is the student law association of the Federal University of
> Technology Owerri (FUTO), Imo State, Nigeria. It operates under the Judiciary of the
> FUTO Students' Union Government (SUG) and is governed by its own written constitution.
> Motto: Justice, Equity, Fairness.

The association trains and represents intending barristers at FUTO. It runs the SUG School
of Paralegal Studies (SSPS), whose Level 1 "I-Barrister" classes teach the basics of law,
student rights and campus political entry. This site publishes the association's governing
documents and every SSPS study material as free downloads.

Key facts:
- Name: FUTO Bar Association, abbreviated FBA. Named in Article 1 of its constitution.
- Parent body: Federal University of Technology, Owerri — Students' Union Government.
- Address: Federal University of Technology, P.M.B. 1526, Owerri, Imo State, Nigeria.
- Contact: futobarassociationofficial@gmail.com
- Constitution: 14 articles, reviewed by the Constitution Review Committee of the 2020/2021
  academic session and approved by the House.
- Principal offices: President, Vice President, Secretary General (who serves as
  Attorney-General of the association), Treasurer, Public Relations Officer.
- Stated objective: to preserve, protect and defend the rule of law in accordance with the
  Human Rights Declaration of the Federal Republic of Nigeria and the constitution of the
  Students' Union Government, among the students of FUTO.

## Pages

- [Home](https://futobarassociation.org/): Overview of the association, its executives, constitutions and study materials.
- [About](https://futobarassociation.org/about.html): Preamble, name and standing, the seven aims and objectives, code of conduct, and the SSPS programme.
- [Executives](https://futobarassociation.org/executives.html): The five principal offices and the duties each carries under Article 5, plus accountability mechanisms.
- [Constitutions](https://futobarassociation.org/constitutions.html): The three governing documents with their full tables of contents.
- [Study Materials](https://futobarassociation.org/study-materials.html): All 18 SSPS files grouped by week, plus the Level 1 course outline and lecture timetable.
- [Legal Aid](https://futobarassociation.org/legal-aid.html): The FBA Legal Aid Clinic. FUTO students report a legal problem with their matric number, choose a student barrister (or let the FBA choose), receive a reference number and track the case status online. Representation is free.
- [Barristers](https://futobarassociation.org/barristers.html): Public profiles of the association's student barristers, with the areas each handles and whether they are taking new cases.
- [Blog](https://futobarassociation.org/blog.html): News posts and legal articles by members, filterable by type and by month. Individual posts are at /post.html?slug=….
- [Archive](https://futobarassociation.org/archive.html): Anonymised summaries of resolved legal aid matters, and every published post grouped by month.

## Constitutions

- [FBA Constitution (PDF, 11 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/constitutions/fba-constitution.pdf): The constitution of the FUTO Bar Association itself.
- [SUG Constitution (PDF, 32 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/constitutions/sug-constitution.pdf): Scanned constitution of the FUTO Students' Union Government.
- [SUG Constitution 2025 (PDF, 28 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/constitutions/sug-constitution-2025-edited.pdf): Edited, searchable 2025 text of the SUG constitution, 28 articles.

## Study materials — course information

- [SSPS Courses Outline, page 1 (JPEG)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/course-information/ssps-course-outline-page-1.jpg): Level 1 goal and syllabi for JCY 111, LAW 112, EPR 113.
- [SSPS Courses Outline, page 2 (JPEG)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/course-information/ssps-course-outline-page-2.jpg): Syllabi for PTS 114, ADV 115, LDR 101.
- [SSPS Lecture Timetable (JPEG)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/course-information/ssps-lecture-timetable.jpg): Wednesday to Friday, 3:00–6:00.

Level 1 courses: JCY 111 Judicial Analysis & Litigation; LAW 112 Jurisprudence &
Constitutional Law; EPR 113 Professional Ethics & Advocacy; PTS 114 Legislative Process &
Time Management; ADV 115 Advocacy, Activism & Petitioning; LDR 101 Leadership 101.

## Study materials — lecturers' notes

- [Sources of Law (PDF, 9 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/lecturers-notes/sources-of-law.pdf): Hierarchy of Nigerian law from the 1999 Constitution to customary and Sharia law.
- [Judicial Analysis and Litigation (PDF, 7 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/lecturers-notes/judicial-analysis-and-litigation.pdf): JCY 111 — etymology and ranks of the judiciary.
- [Roles of Court Officers and Clerks (PDF, 12 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/lecturers-notes/roles-of-court-officers-and-clerks.pdf): JCY 111 — court administration and judicial support functions.
- [Case Examples and Skeleton Arguments (PDF, 3 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/lecturers-notes/case-examples-and-skeleton-arguments.pdf): Moot court preparation using the IRAC method.
- [Steps in Civil and Criminal Litigation (DOCX)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/lecturers-notes/steps-in-civil-and-criminal-litigation.docx): Nigerian civil and criminal procedure.

## Study materials — weekly notes

- [Week 1 (PDF, 5 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/week-01/week-01-notes.pdf): Responsibilities of a barrister.
- [Week 2 (PDF, 3 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/week-02/week-02-notes.pdf): FBA sitting and self-introduction.
- [Week 3 (PDF, 6 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/week-03/week-03-notes.pdf): Advocacy, activism and petitioning (ADV 115).
- [Week 4 (PDF, 6 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/week-04/week-04-notes.pdf): Definition and characteristics of law (LAW 112).
- [Week 5 (PDF, 5 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/week-05/week-05-notes.pdf): Activism, and how it differs from advocacy (ADV 115).
- [Week 6 (PDF, 3 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/week-06/week-06-notes.pdf): Lawyer and client relationship (EPR 113).
- [Week 7 (PDF, 6 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/week-07/week-07-notes.pdf): Basic communication skills and key elements (EPR 113).
- [Week 8 (PDF, 5 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/week-08/week-08-notes.pdf): Public speaking (EPR 113).
- [Week 9 (PDF, 4 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/week-09/week-09-notes.pdf): Strategies for speaking up and taking action (ADV 115).
- [Week 10 (PDF, 3 pages)](https://futobarassociation.org/docs/study-materials/week-10/week-10-notes.pdf): Latin maxims.

## Notes

- Executive officer names and photographs are not yet published; the site shows placeholder
  cards for the five principal offices until the Executive Council confirms them.
- All documents are published for the information of members and may be downloaded freely.
